summary: Advertised the optional engine KV replay endpoint through /server_info, discovered it in both Rust introspection paths, and added a bounded Rust DEALER client that detects live sequence gaps, validates a complete contiguous replay range, and forwards recovered batches before the newer live batch. Truncated, malformed, or timed-out replay responses are rejected without advancing the subscriber cursor. Added process metrics for detected gaps, unavailable replay, requests, successes, failures, and recovered batches.

tests.what_was_measured: Full rebuilt Rust library suite: 548 tests passed, including native ROUTER/DEALER replay framing, live PUB gap repair, truncated-buffer rejection, discovery, metrics, compatibility, and existing router regressions. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/cargo-lib-full.log

Six component KV-event tests passed, covering independent subscribers, multi-publisher isolation, concurrency, and Python/Rust hash parity. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/cargo-component-kv-events.log
Built the changed native sgl-router binary with repository-pinned Rust 1.90 into the private runtime target directory. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/cargo-native-build.log
29 /server_info tests and 12 subtests passed, including replay endpoint advertisement and load-range coexistence. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/python-server-info.log
Three descriptor contract tests passed, including optional replay fields and backward-compatible omission. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/python-kv-descriptor.log

Clippy reached the rebuilt router but is blocked by a pre-existing unrelated nonminimal_bool warning in experimental/sgl-router/src/policies/buckets.rs:167. No replay-path lint diagnostic was emitted. Raw output: reports/j-889563215d40/raw/cargo-clippy.log

gpu_execution_evidence: The feature is HTTP discovery plus CPU/network ZMQ sequencing in the experimental Rust router; it has no GPU numerical output. No model weights or GPU execution were needed, and startup smoke was not used as correctness evidence.
remaining_limitations: No model-serving or distributed workload was run because replay correctness is independent of model architecture and GPU numerics; the native socket-level near-E2E test exercises the actual transport and wire contract.
A replay gap whose earliest missing batch has already been evicted is intentionally left unapplied and counted as a replay failure; the router cannot reconstruct unavailable engine state.
The repository-wide clippy -D warnings gate remains blocked by the unrelated pre-existing warning in policies/buckets.rs:167.
